lastCompletedStory.title: Create centralized dependency-probe helper with classification and waiver semantics

openQuestions: pgrep is classified hard-dependency by default (same reasoning as tmux/git/jq/uuidgen/bun) even though it comes from the same procps package as ps and is therefore also absent in the oven/bun:1.2-slim worker container. Only ps has a documented narrow host-vs-container rationale (test/integration/orch-recycle-pid-resolve.test.ts). If a later migration story finds pgrep needs the same legitimate-environmental carve-out, update its DEP_METADATA entry in test/helpers/test-deps.ts rather than defaulting other unclassified binaries to environmental.
nextStoryContext: test/helpers/test-deps.ts is built but NOT yet wired into any of the ~46 existing scattered Bun.which/spawnSync probes across test/**. A follow-up story should migrate call sites (starting with test/integration/orch-recycle-pid-resolve.test.ts, whose ps-absence rationale was carried into test-deps.ts's DEP_METADATA.ps.rationale per this story's AC3) onto depPreflight/getDepInfo/isAvailable instead of hand-rolled Bun.which checks. Public surface: DepName, DepClassification, DepInfo, getDepInfo, isAvailable, WAIVER_ENV_VAR, parseWaivers, isWaived, depPreflight (+ DepPreflightResult union: {kind:'available'} | {kind:'skip',reason} | {kind:'fail',message}).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.which(name) returns null (not undefined/throw) when the binary is absent from PATH, matching test-deps.ts's `Bun.which(name) !== null` probe and the pre-existing repo convention (e.g. test/orch-agent-allowlist.test.ts, test/integration/orch-recycle-watch.test.ts).
